newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real rises 0.07 pct in quiet session.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real rises 0.07 pct in quiet session.

text.p: Brazil's real rose 0.07 percent to close at 1.0451 real per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market in quiet trade, dealers said.
In late afternoon, the central bank bought dollars at 1.0450 real per greenback to drain liquidity from the market, they said.

According to some traders the excess liquidity was caused in part by dollar inflows. Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Monday surplus of $47 million, traders said.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real dropped 0.02 percent to end at 1.0506 real per dollar, traders said.
In the illegal parallel market, the real ended flat at 1.085 real per dollar.
